product.name: VortexTech LumiSwitch 3.0
product.description: The VortexTech LumiSwitch 3.0 is a next‑generation smart light switch that blends sleek design with advanced connectivity. Its compact 10 × 10 × 3 cm form factor fits standard electrical boxes, while the matte silver finish complements modern interiors. The switch offers dual‑mode control: a physical button for instant on/off and a Wi‑Fi interface that allows remote operation via the VortexTech app or voice assistants. Built on 802.11b/g/n, it supports 120 V/240 V mains and includes a 5 W power consumption rating. Safety features such as overload protection and a child‑lock mode keep households secure. The LumiSwitch 3.0 is ideal for home automation enthusiasts seeking reliable, user‑friendly lighting control.
